positioning: Premium, agency-built public sites for service contractors (Roofing, HVAC, Plumbing, Landscaping, Cleaning).
target_audience: Homeowners seeking reliable local service professionals.
theme_strategy: Provide a base architecture that switches seamlessly between 3 distinct emotional archetypes using a `template` prop. The data (name, logo, services) remains constant, but the visual wrapper changes drastically.

template_1_bold_industrial.name: Bold & Industrial
template_1_bold_industrial.button_style: rounded-none uppercase tracking-[0.1em] font-bold border-2 border-transparent hover:border-[#0A0A0A] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] hover:shadow-none hover:translate-y-1 hover:translate-x-1 transition-all
template_1_bold_industrial.image_treatment: High contrast, sharp edges. Black and white filters on background images with heavy brand-color overlays (e.g., bg-black/70 mix-blend-multiply).

template_2_clean_modern.name: Clean & Modern
template_2_clean_modern.button_style: rounded-lg font-semibold shadow-md hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all
template_2_clean_modern.card_style: rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-white shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300
template_2_clean_modern.image_treatment: Bright, clear, natural lighting. Subtle rounded corners (rounded-xl) on all imagery.

template_3_warm_trustworthy.name: Warm & Trustworthy
template_3_warm_trustworthy.button_style: rounded-full font-bold shadow-sm hover:opacity-90 hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200
template_3_warm_trustworthy.image_treatment: Warm filters. Soft, large rounded corners (rounded-2xl or completely circular for portraits).

header.layout: Sticky top (z-50). Mobile: Logo left, Hamburger right. Desktop: Logo left, Nav center, CTA button right.
header.design_rules: Must have a background. For Bold: Solid white with heavy bottom border. For Clean: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). For Warm: Solid #FAFAFA with soft shadow.

hero.layout: Grid split (text left, image right) OR Center-aligned with massive background image + overlay. Always include trust badges (e.g., 'Licensed & Insured', '20+ Years Experience') above or below the H1.
hero.content: H1 (Business Name/Tagline max text-5xl md:text-6xl+), Subtitle (text-lg md:text-xl), Primary CTA (Call Now), Secondary CTA (Get Free Quote).
hero.design_rules: Overlay opacity max bg-black/50. If text needs contrast, use text-shadow.

services.layout: Bento Grid or CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 md:gap-8).
services.content: Cards with icon (lucide-react), Title, Short description.
services.design_rules: Use the respective template's `card_style`. Icons must use the template's `accent` color.

gallery.design_rules: Images must have object-cover. On hover, slight scale-up (scale-105) inside an overflow-hidden container.

reviews.layout: Horizontal scroll / Swiper carousel or 3-column grid.
reviews.content: Google Review Stars (5 Yellow stars), Customer Name, Review text, 'Verified via Google' badge.
reviews.design_rules: Ensure high contrast for review text. Use quotes typography.

contact_and_booking.layout: Two columns: Left side text + business info (Hours, Areas, Address, Phone), Right side Lead Capture Form.
contact_and_booking.content: Form: Name, Phone, Email, Message, Submit Button. Booking link below or integrated.
contact_and_booking.design_rules: Use Shadcn Form components heavily styled to match the template. Inputs must have clear focus states (e.g., ring-2 ring-primary).

sticky_mobile_cta.layout: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 w-full p-4 bg-white border-t z-50 md:hidden flex justify-between gap-4 shadow-[0_-4px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
sticky_mobile_cta.content: Button 1: Call Now (Icon + Text), Button 2: Get Quote (Icon + Text)
sticky_mobile_cta.design_rules: One button should use `primary` style, the other an outline/secondary style. Ensure safe-area-inset-bottom is respected.

footer.layout: Dark background (e.g., bg-gray-900 text-white) with large padding (py-16).
footer.content: Logo, Quick links, Contact Info, Copyright.
footer.design_rules: Massive text for the final CTA ('Let's Build It' or 'Get Your Free Estimate').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build ONE main React page component (e.g. ContractorSite.jsx) that accepts a `templateKey` prop (bold, clean, warm).
Use a configuration object or CSS variables to swap styles dynamically based on the templateKey without rewriting the HTML structure.
Ensure the hero overlay opacity never exceeds bg-black/50 so images are visible.
Use Lucide-react for all icons (Phone, MapPin, Clock, Star, ShieldCheck).
Implement the sticky mobile bottom CTA using `fixed bottom-0` classes with high z-index and padding-bottom on the main layout to prevent overlap.
DO NOT use generic AI placeholder characters or emojis. Use the provided high-quality image URLs.
Ensure contrast ratios are accessible (use white text on primary color backgrounds).
Apply `data-testid` to all CTAs, forms, and major sections.
Do not center-align body text or lists; always left-align for readability.
Use Shadcn components for the Contact Form and any Modals/Dialogs.

accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px must have at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-label to icon-only buttons. Add aria-hidden='true' to decorative icons.

motion.hover: Buttons and cards must have hover states (transform, shadow, or color shift).
motion.scroll: Consider mild staggered fade-in animations on scroll for Service cards and Gallery images using Framer Motion (only if it doesn't hurt performance).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where specified.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container; do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add subtle grain textures or noise overlays where it fits the aesthetic.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Rely on the provided image URLs.
